title: Dev order: ship the restored_baseline fallback specified on 2026-04-13
intent: Add a dev order for the automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback that docs/archive/2026/status/RECOVERY_BASELINE.md specified on 2026-04-13, marked CRITICAL, and whose own status table still reads 'Ship as fallback | PENDING'. The edge_to_dxf blueprint lane's default extraction has been in a diagnosed regression since f49ead1d (2026-04-12) and the fix was never implemented. Ships alongside it a method record (VECTORIZER_WORKING_RECIPE.md) and a correction to the forensic audit already on main. Documentation only: three Markdown files, no code, and the order authorizes no implementation and no merge.
behavior_change: None. Two new Markdown files under docs/handoffs/ and one modified Markdown file under docs/audit/. No code, configuration, workflow or test is touched. A runnable border-strip script was present in an earlier revision of this branch and has been REMOVED: a script that nothing imports, filed beside an order, is reviewed on its own merits in a separate PR rather than merged inside a documentation change. The order explicitly states it is not an authorization to merge.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds two Markdown documents and modifies one. (1) DEV_ORDER_RESTORED_BASELINE_FALLBACK.md pins the edge_to_dxf regression to f49ead1d (2026-04-12 15:42, 'feat: hierarchy-based isolation'), carries the April benchmark beside a 2026-09-19 re-run, specifies the fallback at the exact return site, repeats April's do-not-modify constraints verbatim, and states the output-size cost up front. (2) VECTORIZER_WORKING_RECIPE.md records the method that produces usable output today, with measured rather than asserted numbers. (3) VECTORIZER_PROVENANCE_FORENSIC_2026-09-17.md is corrected: D-13 is NOT re-attributed to f49ead1d. That attribution was made and withdrawn the same day as cross-lineage -- D-13 is a vectorizer_phase3.py artifact and f49ead1d is an edge_to_dxf.py commit, and the two are separate implementations. D-13's cause is recorded as UNKNOWN and filed against no commit. D-10's 'shared root cause with D-13' wording is withdrawn for the same reason; its own f49ead1d candidacy stands unproven and unbisected.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: RECOVERY_BASELINE.md diagnosed the regression but was archived on 2026-05-02 with its Step 2 unimplemented; no order exists asking for it. Verified 2026-09-19 that no automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback exists anywhere in services/api/app, and that blueprint_async_router.py:147 still defaults to mode='refined'.

commands_run: git log --follow on services/photo-vectorizer/edge_to_dxf.py -> regression window bounded by 86c49526 (2026-04-11 01:41) and f49ead1d (2026-04-12 15:42).
git grep restored_baseline -- services/api/app -> mode is selectable by name only; no automatic fallback exists.

extract_blueprint_to_dxf run with isolate_body True vs False on two production plans, 2026-09-19: Gibson-SG-Custom 16,762 vs 462,053 entities (27.6x); 12 StringDreadnaught_2 12,785 vs 1,071,127 (83.8x).
Rendered both paths for visual comparison: the 12-String refined output is a page border only, reproducing the BORDER_FALLBACK case RECOVERY_BASELINE.md describes.
